collections.title: Scientific Writing
collections.description: Skills for producing academic-style documents and human-sounding prose: journal/conference/thesis .docx output, style-controlled writing, and writing guidelines.

collections.title: Web & Design
collections.description: Skills for building and reviewing web output: anti-slop page design (Hallmark, Impeccable, taste-skill, Anthropic's frontend-design), UI guideline review, and a pinned design-reference selector.

collections.title: Research Connectors
collections.description: Extensions that connect a research session to outside sources: model and dataset hubs, up-to-date library documentation, public code repositories, and offline benchmark statistics. Connections register only; nothing runs until you use it.

collections.title: Lean 4 & Mathlib
collections.description: The Lean FRO's official skills for formal proofs in Lean 4: step-by-step proving, toolchain setup, minimal examples and bisection for bug reports, and the lean4 and Mathlib contribution and review conventions.

collections.title: Motion diagrams
collections.description: Richer diagrams beside OpenAR's built-in motion figures: always-running terminal-style architecture panels rendered frame by frame to MP4, and explorable Archify architecture, sequence and data-flow pages. Exports go through the same poster, GIF/WebP/MP4 and figure manifest as built-in figures.

collections.title: Lean Code
collections.description: Ponytail's lazy-senior-dev skills: write the smallest change that fully solves the task, review a diff or audit a whole repo for bugs, risk, load, missing tests and code that should not exist, and list the deliberate shortcuts left behind.
